checkpoint_audits.notes: Whisper large-v3 graph with 51904 embedding rows and eight declared speaker tokens at IDs 51866 through 51873.

limitations: The native provider returns window-local speaker identities for one audio window of at most 30 seconds.
Cross-window speaker linking needs a separately modeled speaker-embedding and clustering architecture.
Fine-tuning requires inline speaker and 20 ms timestamp targets that satisfy the published speaker-block grammar.
policy: VoiceHub owns architecture, preprocessing, constrained decoding, training, and export execution; external weights are accepted only through strict Safetensors loading.
